title: Guard a method against null and empty input

blocks.text: A method that cannot handle `null` or an empty collection checks for them first, and answers them on purpose instead of failing halfway.

items: one item is singular: `summary(List.of("pen"))` is `"1 item: pen"`;
`null` and an empty list are both `"nothing to process"`.

cases.says: Several items are counted and listed.
An empty list is "nothing to process".
null is "nothing to process", not a NullPointerException.

concepts: A method checks for null and empty inputs it cannot handle before it uses them.
